sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Ten selected parameters including quartz transition eigenstrain sampled in their declared ranges; permeability conditioned on its nominal value after two cost-limited broad-permeability attempts. All other parameters fixed except scenario controls. Results apply only to this constitutive model and selected ranges, not permeability-range robustness or all assumed material parameters. The previous nine-parameter ensemble remains historical.
limitation: Small sample ensemble is exploratory. Wilson bounds explicitly prevent calling a small unanimous sample a proven robust ranking.
